name: Fix Pi resume setup crash
description: Pi crashes during resumed native RPC runs because calling  after startup replaces extension context; the installed pi-cc-header extension later dereferences a stale captured context and exits the process. Launch Pi with  instead, add a regression fixture that fails if switch_session is used, improve setup crash diagnostics with stderr, verify against the exact real session and release build.
result: Reproduced the setup exit deterministically against the exact saved session. Root cause was pi-cc-header retaining a delayed callback across the  RPC; Pi then threw  and exited. name: Set up upstream sync workflow
description:
Create a workflow/script to pull updates from the original zeronsh/comet repo and merge/rebase them into the fork. This involves:

1. Adding the original repo as an  git remote
2. Creating a script/automation to:
   - Fetch upstream changes
   - Check for new releases/tags
   - Merge into local branches
   - Handle conflicts gracefully
3. Setting up a regular sync cadence (e.g., weekly)
4. Documenting the merge conflict resolution strategy (since we'll have custom changes to harness, UI, etc.)

Key considerations:
- The repo is actively developed (v0.2.13, frequent merges)
- Custom changes must survive upstream merges
- The Pi harness and sidebar changes may conflict with upstream UI refactors

name: Fix Pi model selection not working
description:
Currently Pi only advertises ONE hardcoded model ("default") in . The pi-acp adapter passes through pi's own provider config (~/.pi), but Zeron never dynamically discovers models from Pi. The  flow already exists for ACP agents — it probes the agent and reads  — but  likely doesn't advertise model config options since Pi routes everything through its own config. 

**Root cause analysis:**
1.  in  only returns a single Model with id "default"
2. The  at line 844 probes the agent via ACP, but Pi doesn't use the model config option — it reads from 
3.  expects  with category "model" — Pi likely doesn't expose this
4. The static catalog is used as fallback, and it only has "default"

**Fix approach:**
- Investigate what  actually advertises over ACP (run it manually, check initialize + session/new responses)
- Either: make pi-acp advertise real model config options, OR
- Parse pi's config files directly (~/.pi/config, provider settings) to build the model list
- Consider adding a native Pi harness (like Claude/Codex have) that talks to pi's RPC directly instead of going through the ACP adapter
- At minimum, update the static catalog to include common pi models (e.g., the models from pi's configured providers)
result: Pi model selection now reads  and surfaces 87 real models across all configured providers (openai-codex, opencode, opencode-go, etc.). Each model has correct per-model thinking level ladders derived from Pi's own . Dated pinned versions are filtered out. The old single "pi default" entry is now only a fallback when the file can't be read. Builds cleanly, all 5 catalog tests pass.

name: Render Pi subagent child transcripts
description: Extend the native Pi RPC harness to surface pi-subagents child activity as nested AgentEvent::Subagent traffic. Extract child transcript paths from subagent tool results, parse child transcript JSONL records into user/reasoning/text/tool lifecycle/usage/done events correlated to the parent subagent tool-call ID, preserve normal parent ToolResult output, handle multiple children and missing/malformed artifacts safely, add deterministic fake-Pi regression coverage, and verify the nested transcript reaches the existing engine/doc/UI path.
result: Implemented Pi child transcript replay. On a completed  tool execution, the native harness extracts up to 16 child transcript paths from structured result details, resolves and validates the canonical  path, enforces 16 MiB/20k-record bounds, parses child user/assistant/tool lifecycle/usage/error records, and emits them as  correlated to the parent tool-call ID. Multiple child transcripts share one nested run and receive one aggregate terminal status; missing, oversized, malformed, and unexpected paths degrade safely while preserving the parent ToolResult. Added a fake transcript regression covering child prompt, reasoning, read tool call/result, usage, final text, lifecycle completion, and redacted audit suppression. Verification: Pi tests 8/8; engine check passes; engine subagent ID tests 2/2; doc nested chip tests 2/2; Pi-specific clippy clean; release build passes. Restarted target/release/zeron as PID 98726.
